Self Pickup, now on Cart

60% of prepaid users order through Cart, but pickup only lived on Buy Now. We’re bringing the same pickup card to the Cart’s Review step.

01 — Why Cart

Most prepaid orders come through Cart, and Cart had no pickup

Self Pickup is live for prepaid users near partner stores, but only on the Buy Now path. Most of the buyers who could pick up never saw the option.

60% of prepaid users place their order via Cart.

TODO: data source and period for the 60%
02 — Today on Cart

Today, Cart’s Review step has no delivery choice

Cart → Review → Payment. The buyer checks every item on step 1, then sees the address and the same items again on step 2. There’s no slot for pickup anywhere in the flow.

The pickup card lands on step 2, alongside the delivery address that already lives there.

03 — Today on Buy Now

On Buy Now, pickup is a second card under Home delivery

This is the steady state we’re carrying over to Cart. Home stays pre-selected; the pickup card earns attention with a discount band.

Buy Now also has two FTUX variants. Cart takes only the steady state. The price strike inside the card never animates.

04 — Placement

Delivery choice goes above the items, because the items were seen in step 1

Cart is three steps: Cart → Review → Payment. By the time the buyer reaches Review, they’ve just scrolled every item.

Items were seen one step agoStep 1 is the Cart itself: every item, size, quantity and price. Repeating them first on step 2 asks the buyer to re-read what they just checked.
Step 2 has one new decisionThe only new thing on Review is how the order reaches you. That decision goes first.
Cart lists are longBuy Now has one compact product row above delivery. A cart has three or more full item rows; above the delivery choice they’d push the pickup card down by the height of every item.
05 — Final design

Same steady state, now on Cart’s Review step

Plays on every landing on Review, with no quota and no dim. 2.0s, then the card rests green with a “₹60 OFF” band.
